systems.system: School Report Card (SRC) on DHIS2 for Education
systems.platform: DHIS2 for Education, with offline Android data capture
systems.owner: HISP Uganda under the GPE KIX-funded KIX-SEEDS project led by APHRC
systems.tiers: schools, with data focal persons appointed in schools, and districts; subnational project sites

note: No fact: the brief describes school report cards and school-level reporting of indicators on DHIS2 for Education, with no record per learner, and names the national EMIS without saying what schools enter. It states that Uganda had no formal EMIS policy (citing The Observer, March 2025) and that unstable internet hinders the School Report Card dashboards.
